external_comments_since_2026_10_28.body_html: A tool list is paid on every turn it stays in the context, so the size of the list weighs more than the number of servers. The cost sits in what the model reads per request.

And there the registered prediction resolves. Forty of forty against six of forty, both sides on the record before the run - the withheld trajectories were feedback-shaped, and the witness converted them. That is the cleanest ending this series could have had.

The strongest detail in the whole report is the quietest one: the values were already in the catalog. Nothing was added - no new information, no bigger model, no second chance. The only change was making the comparison and its record references explicit. Which is the purest possible confirmation of what the failure was: the model held every number and lacked the subtraction. A ranking claim without its derivation shown is the printed delta one final time, and once the derivation is in the frame, the whole error class disappears. The single-variable design is what lets that be said plainly - history, catalog and invalid answer frozen, only the feedback varied, so the 34-point gap has exactly one candidate cause.

The accounting stayed honest to the end: the 34 old-message continuations withheld rather than silently dropped, the production limit untouched by the research continuation, scope stated to the letter (known-failure contexts, no unseen-case claim, no internal cause), and 0.22.1 prepared but not published - results before release, the amendment order holding through the last page. The arc is complete and almost never seen in public: observation, hypothesis, instrument, holdout, prediction, confirmation, each stage frozen before the next one touched it. Thank you for running it in the open - this thread is now the reference I'll point people to for what it looks like when a builder audits their own claims.

Measuring this against 114M characters of ordinary text is the part most guardrail write-ups skip, and the finding is sharper than "ten-character windows are safe": the 19 hits were never key material, they were the structural prefix every key of a kind shares (JWT header, PEM algorithm identifier). That implies fingerprinting should run over the high-entropy tail only, which is what 0.20.0 landed on after the DKIM false positive, and reproducing that false positive against the shipped binary instead of reasoning about it is what makes the number worth trusting.

The axis I would still want measured is model-mediated resolution: once outside text is in a session, a model can turn a key or an address into something that shares no substring at all ("the third entry in that spreadsheet"), and no window size catches it because the leak carries no fingerprint. Your answer-only case shows you track taint into answer text, so does that same hook fire when the paraphrase is assembled mid-chain and then handed to a properly labelled outbound tool? And is the 6-character wrapped-piece limit a genuine limit, or just expensive to close given the hex-collision floor you already measured?

The freeze-first discipline paid for itself on first use: the prospective set produced a failure class the development contexts never showed. Seven natural errors, all one shape - eligible set correct, ranking wrong. The known-case battery had converged on contradiction failures (price over cap, distance over limit); the new surface says the live residual is optimization, not eligibility. That is exactly what a holdout is for, and it earning its cost immediately is the strongest signal in this whole run.

And the new shape sits precisely where the thread's boundary predicted it would. Eligibility is decidable record-by-record against stated constraints; optimality is a comparative claim - it needs the whole scored set, so it survives any per-record checker. "Not-optimal" with no numbers attached is the printed delta in a new costume: a verdict whose derivation isn't shown. Your selected-versus-best witness is the right instrument because it converts ranking from prose into arithmetic - selected score against best score, a comparison the checker can actually verify. Same law, fourth costume: the verdict must carry its derivation.

Worth registering the prediction before the witness gets its fresh run, while both outcomes are still interesting: if the ranking errors were feedback-shaped - the model never saw the numbers to compare - the witness should convert most of the withheld and unrepaired trajectories. If a residual persists even with the comparison in hand, ranking joins the stubborn case as evidence that some failures aren't information-shaped at all.

And the sequencing on your own protocol deserves naming: frozen results recorded first, instrument changed after, and no claim that the new feedback fixes anything until it earns a fresh run. The amendment habit holding under temptation is the result that makes all the other results readable.

The addendum question has its provisional answer: the failure looks prose-shaped. Ninety-six clean structured proposals, no duplicate keys, no extra prose fields, no retained C/D - on this surface the schema forced replacement where the paragraph allowed accumulation. Your bundle caveat is the right scope for the write-up: contract, catalog and instruction moved together, so "schema alone fixes correction-by-addendum" is not what the data says, and someone will cite it that way unless the claim is scoped. Operationally the bundle result is already usable - the prior that the contract is the active ingredient is strong, because the addendum was a prose affordance, and one field per claim removes exactly that affordance.

The 96/96 has a second reading worth ruling out before it becomes "the gate works": did the trap item survive the catalog change? If the $190-under-$150 contradiction was designed out of the new catalog, then zero natural repair opportunities means the fixture's attack surface left with the old data - a legitimate defense (removing the invitation beats catching the error), but a different claim than "the loop corrects live failures". The natural-failure rate is now unmeasurable on this catalog either way, so the honest next holdout seeds contradictions the new catalog wasn't designed around, not the old C/D shapes.

The seeded 64/64 on first repair does validate the loop mechanics end to end on the structured surface - gate fires, repair arrives clean, frame carries checked data plus the independent notice. Withholding and second-correction staying unmeasured is the right kind of boring: you can't rate paths nothing triggered.
